summary: Tested all requested features: Credentials NTLM hash field with validation, Credential/Proxy PUT endpoints for editing, Direct Interaction Plugin with DNS resolution. Fixed a bug in the Direct Interaction Plugin cache usage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working correctly. Credentials page now has NTLM hash field and edit functionality. Proxy Servers page has edit functionality. Direct Interaction Plugin is registered and working - DNS resolution tested successfully. Menu shows both plugins under Plugins section: SOAP Plugin and Interação Direta.

credentials_ntlm_hash_field.notes: NTLM hash field added to form and DB. Validation enforces password OR NTLM hash required.

credentials_put_endpoint.notes: Edit credentials working. updated_at field tracks changes.

credentials_ui_edit.notes: Edit button on each credential item. Edit mode shows all fields including NTLM hash.

proxy_servers_put_endpoint.notes: Edit proxy servers working. Can update name, IP, port, type, and auth.

proxy_servers_ui_edit.notes: Edit button on each proxy item. Save/Cancel buttons work correctly.

direct_interaction_plugin_get.notes: Returns plugin info with name 'Interação Direta', version 1.0.0, config_schema

direct_interaction_plugin_health.notes: DNS resolution working. Tested with system DNS and custom DNS servers.

direct_interaction_plugin_page.notes: Page shows plugin info, test form, feature status list with DNS as 'Implementado'

plugins_menu.notes: Plugins menu in sidebar shows both: SOAP Plugin and Interação Direta

direct_interaction_cache_bug.issue: Cache methods called incorrectly - get(key) and set(key, value) instead of async get(operation, params) and set(operation, params, response)
direct_interaction_cache_bug.fix: Updated to use await and correct method signatures: await self.cache.get('direct_resolve', cache_params) and await self.cache.set('direct_resolve', cache_params, ip, ttl_hours=24)

mocked_services.tika_ocr: Apache Tika OCR not available in preview environment
